post.title: How to Set Up Custom Monitoring Criteria
post.description: Learn how to effectively set up custom monitoring criteria using WebMonitor.fyi's AI-powered platform.
post.author: Michael Smith

body.raw:
## Introduction

WebMonitor.fyi allows you to tailor your monitoring experience by setting up custom criteria using natural language. This flexibility enables you to track exactly what matters to you. In this guide, we'll walk you through the process of creating custom monitoring rules step by step.


## Step 1: Log In to Your Account

Access your WebMonitor.fyi account by navigating to the login page. If you don't have an account yet, you can easily sign up for a free trial.


## Step 2: Add a New Monitor

Once logged in, click on the "Add New Monitor" button. You'll be prompted to enter the URL of the webpage you want to monitor.


## Step 3: Define Monitoring Criteria

In the criteria section, use natural language to specify what you want to monitor. For example:



- "Notify me when the price drops below $500."

- "Alert me if there's negative sentiment about our brand."

- "Inform me when new job postings for 'Software Engineer' appear."




## Step 4: Set Monitoring Frequency

Choose how often you want the system to check for changes. Options range from every few minutes to once a day, depending on your plan.


## Step 5: Configure Notifications

Select your preferred notification method. WebMonitor.fyi supports email alerts, and higher-tier plans offer SMS and API notifications.


## Step 6: Save and Activate

Review your settings and click "Save". Your custom monitor will now be active, and you'll receive alerts based on the criteria you've set.


## Conclusion

Setting up custom monitoring criteria with WebMonitor.fyi is a straightforward process that empowers you to stay informed about the web content that matters most to you. Start leveraging the power of AI-driven monitoring today to gain valuable insights and maintain a competitive edge.
